If transfer is called with empty _tos array it must revert (i.e., the call cannot succeed), otherwise it may either revert or return true.
If transfer is called with equal-length non-empty arrays and msg.sender is not the hardcoded owner, the call must revert (i.e., it cannot return true).

If transfer is called by the allowed sender with matching non-empty arrays, it returns true and does not change C.from or C.caddress public getters.
Calling transfer from a non-authorized caller must revert (i.e., it cannot return true).
When transfer is called with non-empty matching arrays by the authorized sender, it must return true (i.e., not revert) and leave the public from and caddress getters unchanged.
If transfer is called with empty _tos array, it must revert (cannot return true).
If transfer is invoked by this contract with an empty _tos array, it always reverts (call does not succeed).
